changes.comment: Add `QuantityFieldFormatOptions` to `FieldFormatOptions`, letting a `FieldRun` override the `KindOfQuantity` and persistence unit used to format its value, and name the `FormatSet` that resolves it. `kindOfQuantity` and `persistenceUnit` are independent overrides, but only `kindOfQuantity` falls back to the property's own value: a `persistenceUnit` naming a different unit than the property's suppresses the property-side fallback entirely, so an unresolvable override renders the raw value rather than a number silently formatted through the wrong unit. `@itwin/core-quantity` is now a peer dependency of this package.
